specification:
Type: infographic **sim-id:** training-kit-poster
**Library:** html
**Status:** Specified
**Bloom Level:** Remember
**Bloom Verb:** identify
**Learning Objective:** The learner will identify the eight items of the training kit from a description of how each looks, with at least 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt. **Prerequisites:** Training Kit, Facilitator Guide, Workshop Agenda, Exit Survey, Certificate Submission (all defined in this chapter above this block). **Evidence of Mastery:** In quiz mode the learner clicks the marker that matches a visual hint. A click is correct when it matches the marker named in the Hint column of Content. Mastery is at least 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt. Hovering in explore mode is exploration, not evidence. **Misconceptions:** (1) A kit is only slides. (2) The kit needs no license. (3) The sample resource can be any resource. **Instructional Rationale:** Identifying the items of a kit is a Remember-level task, and a picture of an open box with its contents gives each item a place. The quiz asks the learner to recognize an item by its look. **Content:** The illustration is a text-free flat drawing of an open box seen from above, with eight items inside. One is a sheet with a grid of eight rows and two columns. One is a thick booklet with a bookmark ribbon. One is a short stack of rectangles with a play-button shape on the top one. One is a printed form with boxes and a pencil. One is a document with a ribbon and a row of ten small squares. One is a speech bubble containing short lines and a gear. One is a clipboard with a check mark. One is a card with five stars and a blank line. The eight markers: | # | Label | Hint (describes the look, not the name) | Description | Tip | |---|---|---|---|---| | 1 | Agenda | The sheet with a grid of eight rows and two columns. | The one-page schedule of the day. | Show the time and what teachers leave with. | | 2 | Facilitator guide | The thick booklet with a bookmark ribbon. | Step-by-step directions and fixes for common problems. | Include the answers to every exercise. | | 3 | Slides | The short stack of rectangles with a play-button shape. | Visual support for the short talks. | Keep talks short and practice long. | | 4 | Rubric worksheet | The printed form with boxes and a pencil. | The form teachers fill in during the day. | Use the ten metrics and the evidence column. | | 5 | Sample resource | The document with a ribbon and a row of ten small squares. | The material for the calibration exercise, with consensus scores. | Agree the consensus scores before the day. | | 6 | Agent prompts | The speech bubble with short lines and a gear. | The prompts and setup notes for the agent. | Test the prompts before the day. | | 7 | Certificate checklist | The clipboard with a check mark. | What to submit and how it is reviewed. | Show the 30-day deadline. | | 8 | Surveys | The card with five stars and a blank line. | The exit survey and the follow-up survey. | Keep them short and anonymous. | **Provenance:** The eight items follow the chapter section "Training Kit". The illustration is synthetic, and the sim labels it "illustrative example". **Rules:** Each hint matches exactly one marker. The illustration contains no text, so every label comes from the table above. Markers are numbered 1 to 8 in the order of the table. **Learner Activity:** 1. In explore mode the learner hovers or clicks a marker and reads its label, description, and tip. 2. In quiz mode the sim shows a hint. 3. The learner clicks the marker they think the hint describes. 4. If the first click is wrong, the sim says so and lets the learner try once more. If the second click is also wrong, the sim reveals the marker and its description. 5. After all 8 hints the sim shows the summary. **Feedback:** 8 hints in a shuffled order, two attempts each. Only a correct first click counts as evidence. Correct: "Correct: [label]. [Description]". First wrong click: "Not quite. Look again at the hint: [hint]". Second wrong click: "This is [label]. [Description]". The summary shows "[n] of 8 correct on the first attempt". At 7 or more it adds "You know what goes in the kit." Below 7 it lists the labels of the missed items. **Starting State:** The illustration with eight numbered markers, explore mode active, and the prompt "Hover an item to see what it is for." **Chapter Anchors:** The chapter's table of eight kit items lists the same items.
